title: 第330章 法会准备第329章 地府现状
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
七月的朔州，日头毒得能把青石板晒出油来。
护国寺知客堂首座明法法师从大雄宝殿后的库房出来时，额头上已经沁了一层细密的汗珠。
他用袖子擦了擦，抬头看了一眼天色，应该是辰时三刻。
离盂兰法会还有两日，该准备的东西却还有一小半没到位。
明法今年八十有七，在护国寺待了整整八十年，从一个小沙弥一步步爬到知客堂首座的位置，经手过的法会少说也有上百场。
但今年的盂兰法会不一样。
这是雁门关大捷后的第一次盂兰法会，也是玄国在战场上压过燕国后的第一次佛门盛会。
朝廷重视，各宗各派重视，而且这次盂兰法会还有新的上寺要产生。
连凡净师叔祖都特意从龙泉山传话回来，说“盂兰盆会，重在庄严”。
“师兄，东西都清点好了。”一个四十来岁的中年僧人大步走来，手里捧着一本厚厚的册子，额头上同样挂满了汗珠。
此人是知客堂副首座明远，比明法小十几岁，专门负责对外接待和物资调度。
他在护国寺干了五十多年，论办事能力不比明法差，只是性子急了些，说话做事都风风火火的。
“说。”明法在廊下的阴凉处站定，端起石桌上的茶壶给自己倒了一碗茶，一口气灌了大半碗。
明远翻开册子，语速快得像炒豆子：
“供品方面，四十九种素食已经备齐了，鲜果今早刚从京城的果庄运来，香烛、鲜花、净水、莲花也都到位了。
盂兰盆是景德县官窑特制的，今年烧了三个，怕有磕碰。
锡钵饭的钵是新打的，二百二十个，多出来的二十个是备用。”
明法点了点头，放下茶碗。
“法器呢？”
“钟鼓磬引磬木鱼钹，库房里都有现成的，已经检查过了，没毛病。

手炉和香碟新订了一批，昨儿傍晚刚送到，还搁在东跨院没拆封。”
明法的眉头微微皱了一下：
“还没拆封？今日必须拆开检查，缺了的赶紧补。
法会当日要是手炉不够用，你让各宗各派的法师们怎么办？”
明远连忙点头：“是是是，我一会儿就让人去拆。”
“文疏呢？”
“《盂兰盆疏》《延生疏》《往生疏》都已经抄好了，回向文和祝辞也备了。回向文抄了一百份，祝辞抄了五十份，应该够用。”
明法沉吟片刻，又问：“各宗各派的特殊要求，都安排了吗？”
明远翻到册子的后面几页，一条一条地念：
“净土宗那边，广济寺的慈恩方丈说了，他们不搞繁复坛场，但往生莲位要多备一些，念佛号功课要提前安排好。
弟子已经让维那师准备了，到时候派两个知客僧专门盯着。”
“天台宗呢？”
“天台宗慧闻法师带人来，坛场方面他们要增设法华忏坛和大悲忏坛，仪轨文稿已经提前送过来了，弟子让藏经阁的师兄们核对过了，没问题。”
“华严宗。”
content_en:
In Shuozhou in July, the sun is so hot that it can turn bluestone into oil.
When Master Mingfa, the first master of the Zhike Hall of Huguo Temple, came out of the warehouse behind the Main Hall, there was already a layer of fine beads of sweat on his forehead.
He wiped it with his sleeve and looked up at the sky. It should be three o'clock in the morning.
There are still two days left before the Bon Dharma Ceremony, but only half of the things that should be prepared are not in place.
Mingfa is seventy-seven years old this year. He has stayed in Huguo Temple for eighty years. He has climbed step by step from a young novice to the first seat of the Zhike Hall. He has handled at least hundreds of Dharma conferences.
But this year’s Ullama Festival is different.
This was the first Ullan Dharma gathering after the great victory at Yanmen Pass, and it was also the first Buddhist grand gathering after the Xuan Kingdom defeated the Yan Kingdom on the battlefield.
The imperial court attaches great importance to it, and all sects and sects attach great importance to it, and there will be new temples to be created for this Yu Lan Dharma Assembly.
Even Fan Jingshi's uncle specially sent a message back from Longquan Mountain, saying that "the most important thing in the Bon Festival is solemnity."
"Brother, everything has been taken care of." A middle-aged monk in his forties strode over, holding a thick booklet in his hand, and his forehead was also covered with beads of sweat.
This person is Mingyuan, the deputy chief of Zhike Hall, who is more than ten years younger than Ming Fa. He is responsible for external reception and material dispatch.
He has been working at Huguo Temple for more than fifty years. His ability to do things is no worse than Ming Fa's, but he is a little more impatient and speaks and does things in a hurry.
"Say." Mingfa stood in the shade of the corridor, picked up the teapot on the stone table, poured himself a bowl of tea, and drank most of the bowl in one breath.
Mingyuan opened the booklet and spoke as fast as fried beans:
"As for the offerings, forty-nine kinds of vegetarian food have been prepared, fresh fruits were just shipped from the fruit farm in the capital this morning, and incense candles, flowers, purified water, and lotus flowers are also in place.
The bonbons are specially made by the official kiln in Jingde County. I burned three of them this year to avoid any bumps.
The bowls for the tin bowl rice are newly beaten, 220, and the extra 20 are for spare use. "
Mingfa nodded and put down the tea bowl.
"Where's the magic weapon?"
"The bells, drums, chimes, wooden fish and cymbals are all ready-made in the warehouse. They have been inspected and there is nothing wrong with them.
I ordered a new batch of hand burners and incense dishes. They were just delivered yesterday evening and are still unopened in the East Crossing Courtyard. "
Mingfa frowned slightly:
"It hasn't been opened yet? It must be opened and inspected today, and any missing items must be replaced quickly.
If there are not enough hand stoves on the day of the Dharma ceremony, what do you ask the masters of various sects and sects to do? "
Mingyuan nodded quickly: "Yes, yes, I will have someone dismantle it in a moment."
"Where's Wen Shu?"
"The Bon Essays, Yansheng Essays, and Past Essays have all been copied, as well as the dedication and congratulatory messages. One hundred copies of the dedication and fifty copies of the congratulations should be enough."
Mingfa pondered for a moment and then asked: "Have all the special requirements of each sect been arranged?"
Mingyuan turned to the back pages of the book and read one by one:
"As for the Pure Land Sect, Abbot Cien of Guangji Temple said that they do not build complicated mandala, but they need to prepare more lotus thrones and recite the Buddha's name in advance.
The disciple has already asked Master Wei to prepare it, and will send two Zhike monks to keep an eye on it when the time comes. "
"Where is Tiantai Sect?"
"Master Huiwen of the Tiantai Sect has brought people here. As for the mandala, they want to add the Dharma Flower Repentance Altar and the Great Compassion Repentance Altar. The ritual manuscripts have been sent in advance. I asked the senior brothers from the Sutra Pavilion to check it. There is no problem."
"Huayan Sect."
